body: c2 lead returned BLOCKED, having written no code, no test, no branch and no PR. Its premise is contradicted by primary evidence in this repo.U+000AU+000AThe `criterion N` derivation does not exist in `src/` because it was deleted on purpose on 2026-09-01 in commit 731f4dac, `feat(decisions): stop deriving scope, store it as given`. The spec files the old behaviour as defect D2 at `docs/specs/2026-08-28-continuity-goal-model.md:288`: an omitted scope was fabricated from the lowest open ordinal, and decisions being append-only made a wrong stamp permanent.U+000AU+000AThree things block the criterion as written:U+000AU+002D Two passing tests assert the opposite, `test/spawn/decisions.test.ts:374-378` and `:427-431`, the first stating an omitted scope must be stored as the empty string and never derived from open criteria.U+000AU+002D A contract census at `test/contract/optional-arguments-are-absent.test.ts:116-130` names `criterion 1` explicitly as the canonical forbidden derived value for an omitted optional argument.U+000AU+002D The spec files the behaviour as a defect, not a feature.U+000AU+000AThe narrower reading, deriving only from an explicitly supplied `criterion_id` by id lookup, breaks none of those tests but was rejected on merits: an ordinal is a display position recomputed on every criterion insert (`src/domain/criteria.ts:112-113`), field merge (`src/merge/field-merge.ts:181`) and conflict repair (`src/server/tools/resolve_conflict.ts:294`), so a stored `criterion N` decays while the `criterion_id` already on the link stays correct. That id already has a consumer: `src/render/briefing.ts:162-167` reads it to split key decisions into live and settled lanes.U+000AU+000ASo the contradiction is in the documentation, not the code. `docs/rules/continuity-ledger.md:126-127` still describes the deleted derivation, and its own precedence line at 5-6 says the code wins. The identical stale sentence sits in the global copy at `~/.claude/rules/common/continuity-ledger.md:131`.U+000AU+000ABaseline confirmed green on the untouched tree by the lead: `npm test` exit 0, 818 tests, 818 pass, 0 fail; `npm run typecheck` exit 0.U+000AU+000ACriterion c2 (01M1TSFK1TCY9YASMMS2J20R04) is unsatisfiable as written and needs striking or rewriting through amend_criteria. Awaiting the human's selection between correcting the doc and reinstating the derivation; not recorded as a decision until selected.
